name: Kanae to Meguri to no Sonogo ga Icha Love Sugite Yabai.
original_name: 叶とメグリとのその後がイチャらぶすぎてヤバい。
source:
This is the fan disc for Imouto no Okage de Motesugite Yabai., with after story routes for chara poll leaders Kanae and Meguri. It also features a scenario where you fall in love with both at the same time.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2014/06/11/june-2014-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
这是《Imouto no Okage de Motesugite Yabai.》的粉丝光盘，收录了Chara投票领袖鼎和巡的故事路线。它还具有一个你同时爱上两者的场景。

[来自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2014/06/11/june-2014-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri！[/url]]
